messages.content: I need to find a place to buy in San Leandro california with at least 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. I don't have a car and I have laundry services.

function.name: Homes_2_FindHomeByArea
function.description: Search for properties to rent or buy in a specified city, with filters for the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, as well as the presence of a garage and in-unit laundry facilities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

area.description: The city where the search for properties is conducted, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Los Angeles, CA').

intent.description: The intention behind the property search, either to rent or to buy.

number_of_beds.description: The number of bedrooms required in the property.

number_of_baths.description: The number of bathrooms required in the property.

has_garage.description: Specifies if the property must have a garage.

in_unit_laundry.description: Specifies if the property must have in-unit laundry facilities. The default is 'dontcare', which includes properties regardless of laundry facilities.

function.name: Homes_2_ScheduleVisit
function.description: Schedules a visit to a property on a given date, allowing a prospective buyer or renter to view the property in person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

property_name.description: The exact name of the property or apartment complex to be visited.

visit_date.description: The scheduled date for the property visit, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-04-15'.

visitor_contact.description: The contact information of the visitor, preferably a phone number or email address.

special_requests.description: Any special requests or considerations for the visit, such as accessibility needs or time preferences.

function.name: Messaging_1_ShareLocation
function.description: Shares the current geographic coordinates with a specified contact. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The current location in the format of 'Latitude, Longitude' (e.g., '34.052235, -118.243683').

contact_name.description: The full name of the contact to whom the location will be sent.

function.name: RideSharing_2_GetRide
function.description: Book a cab for a specified destination, with a choice of the number of seats and ride type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

destination.description: The destination address or location for the cab, in the format of 'Street, City, State'.

number_of_seats.description: The number of seats to reserve in the cab.

ride_type.description: The type of cab ride being requested.

message.reasoning:
User wants to find a place to buy in San Leandro, CA with at least 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. They mention they don't have a car and have laundry services. That might mean they want a property with in-unit laundry? Actually they say "I don't have a car and I have laundry services." That could mean they don't need a garage because they don't have a car. And they have laundry services, so maybe they don't care about in-unit laundry? Or they might want in-unit laundry? The phrase "I have laundry services" could mean they have access to laundry services outside the home, so they don't need in-unit laundry. So we can set has_garage to False, and in_unit_laundry to "dontcare" or "False"? The user says "I have laundry services," meaning they don't need in-unit laundry. So we can set in_unit_laundry to "False" or "dontcare". But the function expects "True" | "False" | "dontcare". We can set it to "False" to indicate they don't need in-unit laundry. But the user didn't explicitly ask for no in-unit laundry; they just said they have laundry services. That implies they don't need in-unit laundry. So we can set in_unit_laundry to "False".

We also need to specify the number_of_beds and number_of_baths. The user says at least 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The function requires exact numbers. We can interpret "at least" as we can set number_of_beds=3 and number_of_baths=2. That will return properties with exactly 3 beds and 2 baths. But the user might want at least 3 beds and at least 2 baths. The function doesn't support "at least" but we can set the minimum. We'll set number_of_beds=3 and number_of_baths=2.

We also need to set intent to "buy". So we call Homes_2_FindHomeByArea with area="San Leandro, CA", intent="buy", number_of_beds=3, number_of_baths=2, has_garage=False, in_unit_laundry="False".
